name: pixel_dungeon
description: Pixel-art roguelike. Pick a Warrior, Rogue or Mage and descend twenty floors through the Cellars, Fungal Caverns, Frozen Crypt and Molten Depths. Four bosses telegraph their attacks; level-up perks, unidentified flasks, scrolls, bombs, vaults with keys, shops, shrines and blood altars. Claim the Akira Crystal on B20. Best score saved to NVS.
